correctness.rationale: Each exceptional pair is a product of two radius-one arc charts with exact squared-distance identity. A small-square/outer-strips decomposition gives both exact asymptotic coefficients, and all nonexceptional arc pairs have at most transversal isolated vertex contacts with O(epsilon^2) mass. Change of variables and Scheffe give the marked total-variation law. Deterministic quadrature checks n=3,5,7,9.
